## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] No new dependencies and no new network calls from a hook.
- [ ] A changed or new hook has a test; it still exits 0, runs in under 1 s and prints at most 5 lines.
- [ ] A changed skill `description` or procedure has a case in `evals/cases.json`.
- [ ] OWASP IDs and titles were copied from the official repo, with the date checked (not from memory).
- [ ] `SKILL.md` files stay within their size budget (`test/structure.test.mjs`).
